notes.title: August 28 Update
notes.notes:
[p]Greetings, heroes! As of the August 28, 2025 update, here’s what will change in the game:

[b]Game Events[/b]

— The Cardigan's Mystery 2025 event has been launched.
— Within this activity, players will have access to the [b]Otherland Tricks Seasonal Adventure[/b], featuring over fifty rewards. You can read more about the event in our article via the link:

[b]New Features in Cardigan's Mystery 2025:
[/b]
— You can now move to Otherland by clicking the Seasonal Adventure icon on the Character Panel. Then click the Teleport to Bunny button;
— The character Bunny is now located only in Otherland and has been removed from Varlone;
— The questline now begins after visiting Omnis at the fountain in Varlone. Access to the Seasonal Adventure is granted by Guard Harvest in Illayr;
— Added the activity Minotaur’s Labyrinth. You can visit the fearsome monster by taking the quest “Soulful Tread》 from Alice;
— Added the Baron’s Chest. It appears randomly and contains random useful items. The search for the chest begins after taking the quest “Baron’s Manners》 from Bunny;
— Added Lord Boil. This event boss appears in Illayr, Elgore, Iris and Quedock. You can go hunt him by taking the quest “Boiling with Indignation》 from Bunny;
— Added the questline “Otherland Organization》;
— The Bunny’s shop has been changed.

[b]Balance[/b]  Based on player feedback and analytics, the characteristics of the following Seals have been changed: [b]Seal of the Fiend, Seal of Caligula, Seal of Madness, Seal of the Cardinal’s Robe, Seal of the Ritual Scorpion, Seal of Meditation, Seal of the Old Shoemaker, Seal of the Warrior Ant, Seal of the Brain Racker, Seal of the Dancing Forest, Seal of the Lunatic, Seal of Resourceful Jones. Also there was a change in characteristics of the Card of the Dark Carabus. [u]These changes affect not only Seals and Cards obtained after the update but also all existing ones.[/u][/b][/p][p]

notes.title: March 25 Update
February 12 update
notes.notes:
Hey there! As part of February 12 update, check out what’s waiting for you:

[b]New Additions[/b]

— Links to external web pages are now banned in chat as well as in guild and trade spot names and character overhead announcements;
— Say hello to "Whoosh-2000", new in-game transport;
— New login screen art has been added;то

[b]Game Economy[/b]

— “Saint Vallen’s Day” event is now live;
— Magic Seal Blessing is here too. Your seal upgrades are boosted when using Arconite Sealing Wax;
— Steam Marketplace is back online;
— Some in-game features are now locked behind levels to regulate the activities affecting game economy:
•	Sending mail: Level 15+. Receiving mail: Level 1+;
•	Trading with other players: Level 15+;
•	Setting up trade spots: Level 15+;
•	Using Steam Marketplace in-game: Level 15+;
•	Using Guild Warehouse: Level 20+.
— Boss scrolls are not anymore available for sale in Guild Shop. Guild leaders can now purchase Monster Summoning Seals. Expect more items coming soon.

[b]Fixes
[/b]
— Footstep sounds when using legless transport have been removed;
— Decorations are now displayed correctly when using Cloud Deity;
— Recipes, blood and transmutation cards’ descriptions are now displayed properly;
— The issue allowing players duplicate items in Steam Inventory, bypassing Game Rules has been fixed;
— “Devastator” talent now works properly. Also, when using Earthquake with 0 Fury points, Contusion does not apply to enemies anymore.
Improvements
— When unequipping/swapping gear, the following effects, that have been previously applied, are removed: Poison, Bleeding, Healing, Pain, Burning, Chaos, Vigor, Chill, Contusion, Shock, Plague, Parasite, Seal of Nosferatu;
— Warehouse Ticket icon updated;
— More Catalysts can now be obtained when completing "Total transformation: First Meeting" and "Total transformation: Tranzamples" quests;
— Siege time has been optimized for Astus, Aztec and Ortos servers.

notes.title: Release at 2 PM GMT
notes.notes:
Dear players,

Unfortunately, it will take more time for technical works to be completed. Tentatively until 2 PM GMT. We will inform you about their completion, stay tuned. 
  
We are close to the game release on Steam, we just need a little more time.
We apologize for any inconvenience.

notes.title: Release on December 19
notes.notes:
Dear friends,
On [b]December 19[/b], Royal Quest Online will become available on Steam. Planned access opening: 11AM GMT.

Be sure to log into the game before January 14 and receive the following gifts:

[i]- “Priest of Technology” costume;
- “High Voltage” decoration;
- “Demon Agaliar” (pet);
- 14 days of Premium Status;
- 20 Purple Philosopher's Stones;
- Tor Toise Sealing Wax;
- “Asheema” (mount).[/i]

You can find all the above items in your Golden Chest (on Character Selection screen). Each item can be transferred to any game server, except for Premium Status (can only be applied to the account).

[b]6 servers[/b] will be available for play. Two of them have been opened before Steam release: Helios (popular among the game “veterans) and Ignis (launched in October 2024). Both servers are a part of the European region. Four new servers will be launched from the scratch: Pyros (Europe), Astus (Asia), Aztec and Ortos (American region). Please note that characters cannot be transferred between servers.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/8fe3b2fa93637010c7e41f274a2026bea2acea07.png[/img]

[b]The game is also available on 5 languages now:[/b] English, Russian, Chinese (Simplified), Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Brazil). To change the language, open game settings, select the language you need and restart the game. Certain regional restrictions, however, apply for the main chats’ languages: Europe – English, Russian; Asia - English, Chinese (Simplified); American region - English, Spanish (Latin America), Portuguese (Brazil).

If you are already playing Royal Quest Online on BASE, you can also join the new servers. Login gifts can be obtained the following way: link your Steam account to your BASE account and log in via Steam before [b]January 14[/b]. Instructions on how to link BASE and Steam accounts can be found [url=https://baseplatform.online/royalquest/news]here[/url].

Also, starting from tomorrow all players who logged in via Steam can use Steam Market. Just talk to one of the Maidens when in game and it will unlock access to Steam Inventory. Transfer the items you want to put for sale on Steam Market into your Steam Inventory or collect the items purchased from other players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/a98e9c89f1ba84262c71956957c416bf42e60aef.png[/img]

There will be no difference in game content between the servers. Account’s Reales will also be available on all servers. Exchanging Reales for Gold will be unavailable for now, but will come back soon eventually.
If you don't have a [url=https://baseplatform.online/royalquest/main]BASE [/url]account, we recommend you to get one and link it to your Steam account. This way you will enjoy both BASE and Steam promos and offers. Additionally, you can check the Technical Support page [url=https://baseplatform.online/support/en/bs/rq/help]here[/url].

And that's not all. We decided to honor our most loyal players, who have been impatiently waiting for Royal Quest Online on Steam, with special gifts.
Every player logging into the game via Steam up to and including [b]December 26[/b] will receive a "Royal Greeting" Commemorative Coin (to be sent to player’s Steam Inventory). This Coin will serve as a reminder of the beginning of a new milestone in Royal Quest Online history.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/e601f2ffa5b24b8b2cbc0d988620568c15db2b16.png[/img]

Stay tuned, more new content to be launched soon, and the New Year update is just around the corner!

notes.title: Release on Steam is approved!
notes.notes:
Dear players! We are excited to share with you the long-awaited news: [b]release of Royal Quest on Steam platform is approved![/b].

The long delay made many people nervous, but we are grateful to everyone who is not indifferent to Royal Quest and ready to rush into the game on Steam. Thank you for your patience and support!

At the moment we are preparing all the necessary equipment for the release and launch of [b]four[/b](!) new servers:

[list]
[*] [b]Pyros [/b]in Europe,
[*] [b]Aztec [/b]and [b]Ortos [/b]in America,
[*] [b]Astus[/b] in Asia.
[/list]

The estimated release date is set for [b]December 19[/b].

notes.title: Release date rescheduling
notes.notes:
Dear friends!

Unfortunately, we are still waiting for an answer from Steam platform specialists, and therefore we have to change the release date of Royal Quest on this platform. When the date will be determined, we will publish information about it.

As we wrote last Saturday, the Steam team came up with additional questions when reviewing our game. We have sent all the necessary information and are awaiting permission to release.

We deeply apologize! We are doing everything in our power to speed up the process.

notes.title: Steam Release
notes.notes:
Dear Friends, 

We have some important news for you today. Let's start with the least pleasant one: we are moving the release date of Royal Quest on Steam to October 22. 

It wasn't an easy decision, however, it had to be made due to both internal and external reasons.

Nevertheless, it might also be a blessing in disguise, and moving the release date also means extending the "Call for Heroes" campaign. You'll have more time to add the game to your Wishlists and more chances to get precious gifts at launch. We're absolutely sure that the 18 000 Wishlists mark will be reached very soon! 

There is one more piece of news that will be pleasant and probably unexpected for many players: we are planning to open new servers in different regions for the release, so that as many players as possible could choose a suitable ping and find new friends to chat to in the same language. 

Our servers will be located in the following regions:
— Europe (main languages English, Russian) 
— Asia (main language Chinese (Simplified))
— America (main languages English, Portuguese (Brazil), Spanish (Latin America)) 

Note his list should be used for reference only: each player will be able to choose a server according to their preferences. 

If you are happy with this news, don't be stingy, like, comment and share this information with your friends! 🙂

notes.title: The release date is set!
notes.notes:
Friends!

We are ready to announce the release date of Royal Quest on Steam: October 1, 2024.
From that day you can start your journey through the lands of Elenia.

Soon after, the rewards you've earned will become available:
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2962300/view/4357879827204757719]14 days of Premium Status[/url],
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2962300/view/4357880461173240219]20 Purple Philosopher's Stones[/url],
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2962300/view/4357881096231830110]The Tor Toise sealing wax[/url],
- [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2962300/view/4283572335400008138]The riding animal Asheema[/url].

But that's not all the gifts we've prepared for the release!

Today we are launching a campaign that will last until October 1: “Call for Heroes”.

The more Steam users add Royal Quest to their Wishlists, the more unique gifts all players will receive after release. 

As of now, the game has already been added to 9500 wishlists. 
The first unique gift is waiting for you at the 12000 mark!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45109218/abed9cef775bd34912ee1a8cc60801b4dc51580f.png[/img]

We'll post updates as each mark of the Call for Heroes is reached, revealing more and more information about the campaign. Wanna try to collect all the gifts? 

Call your friends to participate. Add Royal Quest to your Wishlist ;)
